commentary: Karan Sonavale delivers a short carrom ball outside off. Brian Bennett attempts a drive but mistimes it, running a quick single to deep extra cover where Jiten Ramanandi fields the ball.
match_name: Zimbabwe v Oman at Colombo (SSC), ICC Men's T20 World Cup, 9 Feb 2026

commentary: Sonavale delivers a carrom ball wide outside off, pitching back of a length. Sikandar Raza drives it with perfect timing, sending it through extra cover for four. Zimbabwe secure the target emphatically, winning the match by 8 wickets!
